checks.evidence: The parser stages only types and constructors, reconstructs and compares every supplied recursor before installing any current-block recursor, and rolls the whole environment back on failure.
Construction order is shared parameters, every motive, every minor, target indices, target major and result; source BinderInfo is retained for parameters, indices and fields.

Independent review traced motive indices, target indices, dependent field domains, higher-order recursive arguments, IH insertion and the two-stage conclusion-index relocation; no remaining P0/P1 de Bruijn defect was found.

The source scans semantic members breadth-first, deduplicates structural specializations, copies every prior mutual member in source order and builds restored source type/constructor applications without exposing an auxiliary declaration.

Motive/minor counts, result-universe agreement, Prop-elimination decision and K status are derived over the complete transformed group while stored all metadata is restored to the original declared group.

Level-parameter arity and distinctness are derived, undeclared parameters reject, supplied and reconstructed types are mapped positionally to collision-free canonical levels, and stored reconstructed types are remapped to each validated declaration's labels.

Recursive fields match exact restored specializations first, use contextual definitional equality only as a guarded fallback, and reject any unmatched term that still contains a current semantic member.
After definitional agreement, ConstantInfo::Recursor receives only the reconstructed type and derived metadata; the serialized type is never committed.

Tests bind the unchanged control and candidate, assert the exact LALNest.rec_1 mismatch diagnostic, inspect the control's fifth domain, and prove the rejected block leaks no type, constructor, recursor or ownership/group entry.
Focused tests cover indexed Eq metadata, two List specializations, deep parametric nesting and the four-member LCNF mutual group with six transformed motives and nineteen minors.
The unified patch applies cleanly to an exact pristine copy and produces a byte-identical tree; changed paths are limited to four modified source/test files and two exact fixture copies.
rustfmt parsed all four modified Rust files. The pinned tc.rs baseline is not rustfmt-clean, so formatting differences were not applied project-wide.
